figures.shows: The launcher after a project was closed: the left column with its buttons, the closed project as a recent card with its picture, the template and sample cards, and the footer
figures.caption: The launcher after a project was closed: the project comes back as a recent card with its picture, and the footer names the version, the graphics card and the start time.
figures.alt: The launcher window of the editor. A left column holds the buttons New Project, Open Project and Open Sample, and a link at its foot. The main area shows one recent project card with a small picture, its folder and the time it was last opened, then cards to start a new project. A footer line along the bottom gives the version, commit, graphics card and start time, with an About Strata link at the right.

figures.shows: The About Strata dialog over the editor: the table of build and machine details, the Copy Details button and the top of the box of third-party notices
figures.caption: About lists the build and the machine in one table, and Copy Details puts the same rows on the clipboard.
figures.alt: A dialog titled About Strata over the dimmed editor. A mark and the name stand at the top. A table below lists version, commit, platform, graphics card, driver, graphics interface, startup time and interface scale. A Copy Details button follows, then a scrolling box of third-party notices that opens with a table of libraries.
